lexical_neighbors.interpretation: Unordered word-set similarity only; not proof of semantic leakage; no rows removed.

action: audit only; no original split rewritten; no near-duplicate automatically removed
limitations: Labels are existing heuristic/export metadata, not human semantic annotations.
Word counts are not BAGEL tokenizer lengths.
Lexical templates and unordered Jaccard are risk flags, not semantic equivalence.
A prefix of heldout is not a stratified or full-heldout evaluation.

original_export_report.overlap_policy: exclude every official heldout-source prompt from training
original_export_report.deduplication: casefold and whitespace normalization; first occurrence
original_export_report.selection: explicit_regex_v1 count/spatial only; other prompts skipped
original_export_report.category_label_quality: heuristic, not human-reviewed; no semantic success claim

semantic_pack.selection: equal quota per source atomicity; first eligible within group; output source order; no score-based selection
semantic_pack.exclusion: casefold/whitespace normalized exact prompt overlap with reader train and heldout
